input.question: Friday Free-for-All | July 20, 2018
input.ground_truth: Penultimate stretch of the Opium War series tomorrow. I've put off writing it for long enough – let's do this. EDIT: I've also had a bit of an epiphany – the Ever-Victorious Army were basically the Spanish conquistadors to the Anhui Army's Tlaxcalans.

   Imagine it's Friday and your teacher says, "Today, you can talk about anything you want!" That's a "Free-for-All." It means everyone can ask or say anything they like.

2. **July 20, 2018:**  
   This is a date, like your birthday! It tells us exactly when this "Free-for-All" happened. It was a Friday on July 20th, in the year 2018.

So, put together:  
**"Friday Free-for-All | July 20, 2018"**

*"On Friday, July 20, 2018, it was a special day where everyone could talk about anything they wanted!"*
